summary: Search and find all the puzzles and help the natives reassemble the tiny planet.
description:
Welcome to Tiny Planet, a gorgeous steampunk inspired world sadly devastated by a recent asteroid strike.  Your mission is to help rebuild this beautiful idyll and restore it to its former glory.  To do so you'll need to hunt hidden objects in tiny house, solve puzzles and conquer devilish brain teasers in our object finding games.

‘The Tiny Bang Story - search and find games’ is set across five distinct chapters each with their own lovingly hand-drawn location, which combined with the enchanting music created just for this game, adds up to an immersive and crowd-pleasing experience.  With no text in the point and click adventure games users will intuitively find their way around the tiny house, work out what tasks need to be completed next and forge their own path through this unique adventure.  

So sit back, put your thinking cap on and get ready to help the inhabitants of Tiny Planet in The Tiny Bang Story.

Features:

• Top 10 PC download hit on BigFish and Gamehouse.
• Five distinct chapters and over 30 challenging brain teasers (full version game).
• A gorgeous steampunk inspired world drawn entirely by hand.

Please note that this point and click adventure game requires an additional 50-100Mb download when first run, depending on your device.  Additional data charges may apply. An Internet connection is required for verification the first three times you launch the game.
